messages:
devon_csm: FYI — Larkwell usage dropped ~62% week-over-week. Procurement sent a cost-review note this morning. Flagging renewal as at-risk, need quick triage.

maria_cs: Yikes. Thanks for the heads up. Do we have recent seat activity, token counts, and who the current champion is?

devon_csm: Quick numbers dump:
```
30d tokens: 1,240,000 -> 470,000 (-62%)
Active seats: 18 -> 7
Daily avg requests: 420 -> 160
Last heavy pipeline run: 2026-03-14
Revenue tier: Pro (monthly commit)
```
Champion = Evan (Product). Note: VP Eng (Marta) left ~3wks ago; interim Eng lead Simon is doing vendor re-eval. Procurement asked for TCO comparison vs NimbleAI.

aj_sales: On it — I can join a call with Evan + procurement. @maria_cs can you prep a 1-slide cost delta + one-pager on quick wins? I’ll ping Evan to schedule.

maria_cs: Yep — will pull a token-level heatmap and list top 5 routes driving cost. Also recommend a focused 30m ‘surgery’ workshop to walk them through batching + prefix caching.

ops_bot: Support ticket #SUP-1189 created 2026-03-10 for intermittent 502s during peak pipeline runs. Could be churn driver. Link: https://redwood.support/t/SUP-1189

tara_support: I can draft the workshop runbook and a short checklist for their infra team — include Dedicated/reserved options if cost is the angle.

devon_csm: Proposed immediate actions (P1):
- Schedule 30m triage call this week with Evan + procurement + Simon (owner: aj_sales)
- Share usage delta + top costly routes (owner: maria_cs)
- Run short side-by-side TCO snapshot vs NimbleAI (owner: aj_sales + devops runbook)
- Offer a 6-week technical QBR and a pilot of a quantized model to cut inference cost (owner: devon_csm)

maria_cs: I’ll have the deck + heatmap ready by EOD tomorrow and a short checklist for the surgery.

aj_sales: Reaching out to Evan now. If procurement pushes NimbleAI, request a quick proof-of-value: same test set, 2-week traffic, measure latency, cost, and failure rate.

devon_csm: Also note: we should call out recent reliability blips (SUP-1189) in the deck and our remediation steps — transparency will help.

maria_cs: Agreed. I’ll include a slide: incident summary, fix timeline, and current SLOs.

tara_support: I’ll assemble the runbook and a short FAQ for procurement on data controls + private deployment options.

aj_sales: Meeting tentatively penciled for Thu 3/26 11am PT — will confirm.

devon_csm: Thanks all. Tagging renewal-team and will update thread after call confirmed. :thumbsup:
